rudycelekli/kin-connect.change: Kin separates local profiles and preferences from the introduction decision. Agents can propose a match after checking both policies, and both people approve independently before encrypted chat opens.
rudycelekli/kin-connect.validation: The public design documents the approval sequence. It does not measure match quality or establish audited security.

rudycelekli/kya-evidence.title: Portable assurance for exact agent configurations
rudycelekli/kya-evidence.problem: A model or agent name leaves out the tool set, configuration, and policy needed to interpret an assurance check.
rudycelekli/kya-evidence.change: KYA Evidence signs check receipts against an exact manifest and lets a relying party evaluate the receipts under its own policy. The reference implementation packages these inputs into dossiers for review and replay.
rudycelekli/kya-evidence.validation: The public repository documents the reference format and evaluator controls. Industry adoption and independent assurance remain open questions.

rudycelekli/lifeweave.title: Goal-driven local interfaces
rudycelekli/lifeweave.problem: A goal remains abstract until the system can use relevant, consented evidence to surface a concrete next action.
rudycelekli/lifeweave.change: LifeWeave uses a local rule-driven baseline to turn evidence into interfaces such as focus planning and overdue-commitment review. The dashboard places supporting evidence next to controls.
rudycelekli/lifeweave.validation: The public toolkit documents the rule-driven baseline. Habit improvement and retention require user studies.

rudycelekli/mcpsnitch.title: Inspectable observations at the MCP boundary
rudycelekli/mcpsnitch.problem: MCP tool descriptions alone give a reviewer limited evidence about the visible traffic produced by a tool session.
rudycelekli/mcpsnitch.change: MCPSnitch interposes between an MCP client and server, records visible protocol traffic, and can add best-effort process observations to a verifiable session report.
rudycelekli/mcpsnitch.validation: The public developer preview documents its observation model. Activity outside the instrumented boundary remains outside the report.

rudycelekli/nabrix-waitlist.title: A lead intake path for a neighborhood-report waitlist
rudycelekli/nabrix-waitlist.problem: A waitlist needs to transfer the information a visitor submits from the page into the intended intake system.
rudycelekli/nabrix-waitlist.change: Nabrix uses a Next.js landing page and a server-side API route documented as forwarding the form to AGNTCS CRM. The public repository exposes the intake architecture.
rudycelekli/nabrix-waitlist.validation: The source documents the handoff. CRM connectivity, deliveries, and conversion have no live measurement in this study.

rudycelekli/nerve.title: Baseline comparison for steady machine sounds
rudycelekli/nerve.problem: A periodic sound check is easier to interpret when it is compared to a normal recording taken from the same position.
rudycelekli/nerve.change: NERVE analyzes audio locally in the browser and compares numeric features of the baseline and later recording. It highlights which parts of the sound changed.
rudycelekli/nerve.validation: The README describes the capture protocol and local comparison. Fault diagnosis and field accuracy require ground-truth machine data.

rudycelekli/open-teammates.title: Durable work records for an event-planning agent
rudycelekli/open-teammates.problem: A recurring events role needs continuity across planning, logistics and follow-up, including budget and attendee decisions.
rudycelekli/open-teammates.change: Open Teammates publishes Mira as an event-planning role with editable personality files, tooling, and a persistent work ledger. Artifacts make the planned workflow inspectable across steps.
rudycelekli/open-teammates.validation: The repository documents the role and artifacts. Effectiveness as an event operator remains an evaluation question.

rudycelekli/proofseal.title: Behavioral regression memory for coding agents
rudycelekli/proofseal.problem: A code change can preserve the existing unit suite while changing an observable behavior that the suite never pinned.
rudycelekli/proofseal.change: ProofSeal records behavioral baselines as seals and exposes comparisons over MCP, a CLI, and CI. It returns different statuses for drift, regression, and missing evidence so an agent can tell when a baseline is unavailable.
rudycelekli/proofseal.validation: The pinned documentation describes comparison, history, and bisection. The checks depend on the coverage and determinism of the behaviors that are sealed.

rudycelekli/rcode.title: Receipts and undo in an extensible coding agent
rudycelekli/rcode.problem: Model and tool flexibility increase the number of actions a user needs to inspect and potentially reverse.
rudycelekli/rcode.change: rcode exposes terminal and command-center interfaces with configurable model routes. The project describes turn receipts, approval controls and undo for file changes.
rudycelekli/rcode.validation: The pinned documentation describes those interfaces and controls. Provider behavior and permission enforcement require tests with the chosen configuration.

rudycelekli/regentics-landing.title: Static product positioning for AI leadership workflows
rudycelekli/regentics-landing.problem: A prospective buyer needs to understand role boundaries and approval and audit concepts before considering agent delegation.
rudycelekli/regentics-landing.change: The Regentics page presents AI leadership roles and describes approvals and audit trails in a static HTML landing page. Discovery files accompany the page source.
rudycelekli/regentics-landing.validation: The revision documents product messaging and a crawl surface. Feature delivery and conversion need separate verification.

rudycelekli/rudycelekli.github.io.title: Traceable authorship on a static research profile
rudycelekli/rudycelekli.github.io.problem: An evidence dashboard can mix identity claims, time-varying activity counts, and links to accepted changes in ways that obscure their sources.
rudycelekli/rudycelekli.github.io.change: The site keeps visible identity aligned with structured Person and ProfilePage data and refreshes public contribution evidence separately. It provides raw HTML, Markdown, JSON, and an Atom feed for different readers.
rudycelekli/rudycelekli.github.io.validation: The pinned README describes provenance and the refresh pipeline. Crawl access, indexing, and search referrals are measured separately.

rudycelekli/scrapmind.title: Planning inventions against a real inventory
rudycelekli/scrapmind.problem: An invention plan can quietly require an absent part or allocate the same part to two physical roles.
rudycelekli/scrapmind.change: Scrapmind combines generated invention drafts with a resource assignment planner that records part roles, substitutions, and missing materials. A Device Alchemy flow adapts the planning idea to spare devices.
rudycelekli/scrapmind.validation: The source documents inventory-aware planning. Feasibility, safety, and actual fit still depend on materials and physical validation.

rudycelekli/sponsorline.title: Auditing consent in a coding-tool sponsor channel
rudycelekli/sponsorline.problem: Developers need a way to inspect whether an impression was displayed under consent and how it was selected.
rudycelekli/sponsorline.change: Sponsorline binds impressions to signed consent records and documents replay of auction decisions. The opt-in status-line design links the display to those records.
rudycelekli/sponsorline.validation: The repository describes an auditable workflow. Live payouts depend on identity verification and payment rails.

rudycelekli/swarmwatch.title: Live topology for multi-agent runs
rudycelekli/swarmwatch.problem: Observing a swarm from logs after the run makes it difficult to see active relationships, costs and alarms while work is in progress.
rudycelekli/swarmwatch.change: SwarmWatch documents two mechanisms. Process-live launches and supervises an agent command, while stream-live follows an event stream from a running system. The interface renders topology and controls from those inputs.
rudycelekli/swarmwatch.validation: The project documents both collection modes. Control and data completeness depend on which process or stream is attached.

rudycelekli/testlore.title: Preserving evidence from native test tools
rudycelekli/testlore.problem: When an agent reports that a task passed, a reviewer needs the original test evidence and the conditions under which it was collected.
rudycelekli/testlore.change: TestLore is designed to observe native test runs, attach signed evidence, and let reviewers challenge claims and record outcomes. The project includes individual workflow definitions for smoke tests and public pilots.
rudycelekli/testlore.validation: The README and workflow definitions document evidence collection and challenge paths. This case makes no cross-project quality estimate.

rudycelekli/the-value-engine-benchmark.title: Grading multi-turn enterprise negotiation
rudycelekli/the-value-engine-benchmark.problem: Success in a multi-touch sales negotiation depends on decisions across the episode, which a single-turn score misses.
rudycelekli/the-value-engine-benchmark.change: The Value Engine Benchmark puts a model in the seller role against a stochastic buyer and applies a rubric after the negotiation episode. The repository publishes offline materials for inspecting evidence and methodology.
rudycelekli/the-value-engine-benchmark.validation: The source supports a benchmark of simulated negotiations. It supplies no live sales conversion measurement.

ruvnet/ruflo.title: Keep distinct inputs separate in Ruflo's embedding cache
ruvnet/ruflo.problem: Two equal-length strings with a reproducible FNV-1a collision used the same persistent cache slot. An embedding stored for one input could overwrite the vector for the other.
ruvnet/ruflo.change: Use versioned SHA-256 keys over the original UTF-16 code units so the cache also distinguishes JavaScript strings containing isolated surrogates. Legacy entries become cold misses and are rebuilt on demand.
ruvnet/ruflo.validation: The pull request documents a failing-then-passing regression that reopens the SQLite store. Its local full-suite attempts had dependency, fixture and disk-space failures.

ruvnet/RuVector.title: Rejecting malformed vector segments in RuVector WASM
ruvnet/RuVector.problem: Opening an invalid RVF buffer could skip a malformed vector segment or fall back to a one-dimensional store, leaving callers with a store that misrepresented the data.
ruvnet/RuVector.change: The WASM open path fails if a vector segment is truncated, lacks a usable dimension or disagrees with a preceding segment.
ruvnet/RuVector.validation: The merge record notes an initial local linker limitation and reports a later 17-test pass on the merged tree. It also records a supply-chain check failure shared with its comparison run on main.

smart-mcp-proxy/mcpproxy-go.title: Preserve existing credential references during conversion
smart-mcp-proxy/mcpproxy-go.problem: MCPProxy's conversion API recognized a narrow set of reference prefixes. A file reference or a reference embedded in an Authorization header could be put into the keyring as literal text and left unresolved after the next expansion.
smart-mcp-proxy/mcpproxy-go.change: Use the shared reference detector before writing a new secret. The conversion endpoint returns its existing validation error when it finds a reference anywhere in the value.
smart-mcp-proxy/mcpproxy-go.validation: The pull request reports two regressions for file and embedded references and a passing HTTP API package suite. The tests cover rejection before secret resolution.

Softeria/ms-365-mcp-server.title: Enforcing tool boundaries and signing mail according to its schema
Softeria/ms-365-mcp-server.problem: A Microsoft 365 MCP client could receive account-management tools under restrictive stdio settings. Separately, generated mail schemas used PascalCase body keys while the signing path read lowercase keys, causing signed sends to fail and some replies to miss the configured signature.
Softeria/ms-365-mcp-server.change: The stdio registration now applies tool-name and read-only filters and skips MSAL account tools under an environment-token session. The signing helper accepts both supported key spellings and writes back through the spelling the caller used. A third change avoids quadratic email-redaction matching on long attachment text.
Softeria/ms-365-mcp-server.validation: The PRs report focused filter, signature, and redaction checks. The signature suite went from two failing regressions to 38 passing tests, and the performance report includes a size-doubling baseline for redaction. The mail tests exercise request construction without live Microsoft Graph delivery.

steipete/poltergeist.title: Reporting signal-terminated build commands as failures
steipete/poltergeist.problem: A child process killed by a signal closes with a null exit code. Poltergeist converted that value to zero, allowing a terminated build or hook command to look like a success.
steipete/poltergeist.change: The upstream consolidation includes the reported command-runner fix alongside lifecycle and watch fixes. A signal-terminated process produces a failure status, including exit 143 for SIGTERM on the tested platform. Callers that allow nonzero exits still receive that status.
steipete/poltergeist.validation: The original PR includes macOS arm64 receipts using the compiled runner and owned child processes. The baseline returns zero, the candidate returns 143, and the healthy control returns zero. The co-authored consolidation records 13 failing baseline regressions and passing exact-head Linux, macOS and Windows CI.

storytold/craft-anything.title: Representing missing ACP token counts in Craft Anything
storytold/craft-anything.problem: Craft Anything showed zero tokens when an ACP agent supplied no per-turn counts. ACP context occupancy is a different measure and cannot establish input or output usage.
storytold/craft-anything.change: The CLI and activity feed represent unknown turns explicitly. Project and session totals retain counts that were actually reported and display a lower bound when some turns remain unknown.
storytold/craft-anything.validation: The PR reports an ACP fixture and a desktop save-and-reopen case. The AI crate and CLI suites passed locally, and the merge record describes an unrelated engine fixture failure.

Sumanth077/Hands-On-AI-Engineering.title: Restore runnable source for an OCR reference project
Sumanth077/Hands-On-AI-Engineering.problem: An OCR example contained unresolved merge markers in its environment template, Python application, processor and schema files. Those markers left parts of the reference implementation unreadable to Python.
Sumanth077/Hands-On-AI-Engineering.change: Resolve the affected files to the same committed side already used by the example's README, restoring consistency between the documented inputs and source.
Sumanth077/Hands-On-AI-Engineering.validation: The PR reports a clean conflict-marker scan and successful Python compilation of the example directory. Compilation does not exercise the OCR provider.

Tencent/WeKnora.title: Reassembling multiline provider events in WeKnora
Tencent/WeKnora.problem: A valid model-provider SSE packet can split its JSON across several data lines. Decoding each line as a standalone packet could lose the provider response.
Tencent/WeKnora.change: The reader assembles incomplete packets, recognizes a leading BOM and multiple line-ending formats, and applies the existing 1 MiB limit to the assembled data. Complete packets can still arrive during an open connection.
Tencent/WeKnora.validation: The PR reports 25 passing focused cases, including open io.Pipe streams, partial reads and size limits. It records broader local checks blocked by uncached dependencies.

The-PR-Agent/pr-agent.title: Preserving physical Git lines in PR-Agent
The-PR-Agent/pr-agent.problem: Python's generic line splitting recognizes characters such as U+2028 that Git treats as ordinary content. A supplied diff containing one of those characters could shift hunk positions or lose source text.
The-PR-Agent/pr-agent.change: The reverse patcher uses an LF-aware splitter and consumes at most one end-of-line carriage return. The MOSAICO reader also iterates over LF-delimited lines.
The-PR-Agent/pr-agent.validation: The PR reports 43 focused checks. The linked offline replay separately documents baseline and corrected outputs for Unicode separators, later hunks and carriage returns.

thedotmack/claude-mem.title: Restore project merges when importing memory
thedotmack/claude-mem.problem: A claude-mem export retained the destination project of merged observations and session summaries. The import dropped that link, so restored records disappeared from searches and context scoped to the merged project.
thedotmack/claude-mem.change: Persist the merge destination on both imported row types and invalidate context for the destination project. Keep that mutable field outside the matching logic so an earlier export still matches a record that has since moved.
thedotmack/claude-mem.validation: The pull request reports a failing regression on the original import path, followed by 352 passing tests across SQLite, project merge, context caching and semantic persistence.

Thysrael/Horizon.title: Keeping healthy GDELT items in Horizon source batches
Thysrael/Horizon.problem: One GDELT entry with an unexpected field type could raise before validation and discard the whole batch, including otherwise usable articles.
Thysrael/Horizon.change: Horizon now validates the title, URL and date as strings before cleaning their values, so the reader can reject the malformed item and continue through its siblings.
Thysrael/Horizon.validation: The merge record reports that a mixed-batch regression failed on the earlier code and the focused GDELT suite passed 11 tests after the change, with HTTP fixtures.

tigerless-labs/agent-memory.title: Validate a new embedding before replacing a cached projection
tigerless-labs/agent-memory.problem: A malformed embedding response could cause agent-memory to discard its previous dense projection. That turned an invalid refresh into the loss of usable cached data.
tigerless-labs/agent-memory.change: Validate vector shape and finite values, then pack the complete candidate before swapping it in. Malformed input leaves the previous projection available.
tigerless-labs/agent-memory.validation: The PR reports a baseline regression failure and passing isolated runtime tests and lint after the fix. The record also notes a separate pre-existing mypy diagnostic.

tigerless-labs/autoharness.title: Read complete provenance records in autoharness
tigerless-labs/autoharness.problem: A provenance reader could open the ledger while the append path was still writing a record. Parsing a partially written entry made concurrent evidence inspection unreliable.
tigerless-labs/autoharness.change: Make reads and appends acquire the same ledger lock. Keep the append-only data format and existing records.
tigerless-labs/autoharness.validation: The pull request reports a baseline regression failure and passing focused and full non-live pytest suites after the change. The tests use temporary files and mocked child processes.

tigerless-labs/cost-xray.title: Capture complete server-sent events in cost-xray
tigerless-labs/cost-xray.problem: The API-capture path decoded SSE data before it had assembled each full event. A JSON object split across multiple data fields could be lost from the captured stream.
tigerless-labs/cost-xray.change: Join data fields according to SSE event boundaries and decode the resulting payload. Continue collecting after non-object events.
tigerless-labs/cost-xray.validation: The pull request reports a before-and-after regression and 226 passing isolated tests, with two skips. The check uses local inputs and no live provider.

truefoundry/trueforge.title: Aligning TrueForge SDK documentation with the runtime contract
truefoundry/trueforge.problem: TrueForge custom-host examples suggested that streaming events accepted arbitrary names, that agent search returned an array, and that offset-based pagination types were public. These discrepancies made it easy to copy code that did not match the supported SDK surface.
truefoundry/trueforge.change: The merged documentation describes the discriminated streaming event union, points to the public UI import, and preserves the need to validate network JSON. The agent search example now returns ListResult with a page token, and the custom-host reference lists the existing optional ports and context hooks.
truefoundry/trueforge.validation: The pull requests describe comparisons with runtime types and package exports, with documentation consistency checks failing on the unchanged base and passing after correction. The evidence covers reference accuracy. Full workspace and documentation rendering checks were outside the reported validation.

tt-a1i/archify.title: Returning keyboard focus after copying from Archify
tt-a1i/archify.problem: When clipboard access failed or was unavailable, the fallback selected a temporary field. Removing the field could leave keyboard focus on the document body.
tt-a1i/archify.change: The fallback remembers the focused element, removes the temporary field, and restores focus if the original element is still connected.
tt-a1i/archify.validation: Controlled Chrome probes covered fallback success, false and exception outcomes. The merge record credits Rudy Celekli as original contributor and documents the maintainer's later integration with Codex assistance.

vectorize-io/hindsight.title: Keeping HTTP status visible in Hindsight CLI errors
vectorize-io/hindsight.problem: Diagnostic words in a server response body could override the real HTTP status shown to an operator. For example, a 403 whose body mentioned a timeout could appear to be a transport failure.
vectorize-io/hindsight.change: The classifier now uses the HTTP failure heading while the formatter keeps the complete response detail. Genuine transport errors continue through their existing classification.
vectorize-io/hindsight.validation: Two formatter regressions reproduced status misclassification in the existing error module. The contribution reports passing cases for both and separate controls for transport errors. The fixtures exercise formatter behavior offline.

we-promise/sure.title: Correcting the cash direction of CoinSpot trades in Sure
we-promise/sure.problem: CoinSpot buys were imported as cash inflows and sells as outflows. Under Sure's balance convention, depositing 300 AUD and buying 100 AUD could therefore display 400 AUD of cash.
we-promise/sure.change: The order processor uses a positive amount for a buy and a negative amount for a sell. Reprocessing the same external order applies the corrected amount to its existing entry.
we-promise/sure.validation: The PR reports a source-revert failure on the buy assertion and 42 focused Rails runs with zero failures. It also records broader suite failures reproduced on the unchanged baseline.

wheresryan22/anatomy.title: Reject star polygons at the convex prism boundary
wheresryan22/anatomy.problem: Anatomy's prism builder checked whether vertex turns had consistent signs. A regular star can satisfy that condition while winding twice, violating the assumptions of convex-part rendering and collision logic.
wheresryan22/anatomy.change: Require one complete turn around the ring and ignore repeated vertices in the turn calculation. Convex rings, collinear points and ordinary rounded rectangles retain their valid paths.
wheresryan22/anatomy.validation: The PR reports two failing star-polygon cases on the baseline and all 30 checks passing across the relevant geometry suites. Generated examples were rebuilt with unchanged output.

xerj-org/xerj.title: Recording contributor attribution in the Xerj project
xerj-org/xerj.problem: Xerj's contributor list is a public attribution source distinct from technical evidence about its search engine or MCP server.
xerj-org/xerj.change: The merged pull request adds the GitHub login rudycelekli to the contributor list. Its scope is contributor attribution.
xerj-org/xerj.validation: The GitHub merge record verifies the attribution edit. This entry documents the roster change, with no associated runtime measurements.

Yeachan-Heo/oh-my-claudecode.title: Report every unmerged path to a rebasing worker
Yeachan-Heo/oh-my-claudecode.problem: The team orchestrator only recognized three Git conflict statuses when notifying a worker about a stalled rebase. A path modified by one side and deleted by the other could be missing from the worker's inbox and rebase event.
Yeachan-Heo/oh-my-claudecode.change: Parse the full set of unmerged porcelain statuses, including the modify/delete and one-sided add entries. Keep ordinary modifications outside the conflict list.
Yeachan-Heo/oh-my-claudecode.validation: The PR reports one baseline regression failure and 27 passing merge-orchestrator tests in each of two local reruns. The test exercises the message path using the repository's Git mocks.

yutto-dev/yutto.title: Rounding SRT times at millisecond boundaries
yutto-dev/yutto.problem: Splitting floating-point seconds into components and truncating fractional milliseconds could subtract one millisecond from the intended subtitle timestamp. Values near a minute rollover could also stop just short of the next minute.
yutto-dev/yutto.change: The formatter rounds the entire timestamp to integer milliseconds first, then decomposes it with integer division. Carry into seconds and minutes follows directly from that representation.

zhayujie/CowAgent.title: Block shared address space in CowAgent's URL guard
zhayujie/CowAgent.problem: CowAgent's opt-in SSRF guard enumerated several private address categories. Shared IPv4 addresses in 100.64.0.0/10 could pass the checks, including an address used for a cloud instance metadata endpoint.
zhayujie/CowAgent.change: Require global reachability alongside the existing address checks. The guard now rejects shared addresses while keeping ordinary public IPv4 and IPv6 addresses admissible.
